experience.title: Simplifi | Enterprise Workflow Automation Platform
experience.period: Lead Software Engineer & Solutions Architect · 02/2023 – Present
experience.description: As the Solution Architect and Lead Engineer, I designed Simplifi, a mission-critical platform automating master data workflows, GRC controls, and compliance reporting for 400+ users. I architected a NestJS gateway for SAP PO/SO/PR approval automation (contract-first OpenAPI, idempotent ingestion, transactional outbox with dead-letter retry) and a bi-directional SAP/Salesforce integration hub, alongside a Python/FastAPI service layer for automated SoD compliance checks. The platform runs on a high-availability Azure environment with full observability (logging, correlation IDs, Slack alerting), with services Dockerized into air-gapped VMs behind nginx/Azure Application Gateway.
